note: shift_*_hz_at_T = static (leading-order) term only. dyn_*_hz_at_T = full static+dynamic term via Planck-spectrum integral of alpha(omega), validated against the Itano <E^2>_T formula and the Farley-Wing high-n closed form (Beloy et al. 2025, arXiv:2507.00948, Sec. II). rates = bound-bound BBR depopulation from lifetimes.json; tau_eff includes Gamma_PI when continuum block is present. continuum = Beterov eq.27 PI (A_L + QD phases) + optional SFI (--field) + multi-step mixing (eq.35; --no-mix to skip); Gamma_quench = Gamma_BBR + Gamma_PI. rydberg_shifts = static Itano + principal-value Planck dyn with TRK/tail/Kramers continuum completion (Farley-Wing asymptote); for high-n labels (no dynamic integral).

rates.note: bound-bound BBR only; stimulated emission + absorption via Einstein A and nbar(omega,T). No continuum photoionization.

continuum.method: Beterov et al. NJP 11, 013052 (2009) eq. (27) with Table-2 A_L and quantum-defect phase weights; eq. (30) SFI at E=100 V/cm (n_c=42.295); eq. (35) mixing with gate t1=3e-07s, t2=2.1e-06s, |dn|<=3
continuum.note: Gamma_PI = direct BBR photoionization. Gamma_SFI = BBR to n>=n_c then field-ionized (--field). Gamma_mix_* = ionization via neighbors (eq.35; gated t1,t2). Gamma_ion = PI + SFI + mix_PI + mix_SFI. Gamma_quench / free-space tau_eff = Gamma_BBR + Gamma_PI only.

rydberg_shifts.note: static Itano from on-the-fly alpha(0) SOS; n_pad=5: avoid states within 5 of series n_max. dynamic Planck integral, each channel a principal value; Farley-Wing asymptote +2416.6658 Hz at T=300 K. Dyn network: QDT discrete tail + TRK closure (scale signed f to 1) + Kramers continuum residual; dyn_reliable=false where f_cont > 1 (a nearby partner is missing from the network). Series repair: QDT-model levels at the formula energy (not the 1e-6 eV rounding), g-f pairs lost to tied rounded energies restored, synthetic h series (QDT energies, Coulomb/Numerov f) added as g partners. static_valid=false where second-order theory fails (coupling d.E_rms > 0.3 x gap) or over 10% of alpha(0) comes from partners below k_B T; the dynamic shift is the one to use there.
